design_principles.name: Patron first
design_principles.statement: Every desk step starts from the patron in front of the desk.

design_principles.name: One record per book
design_principles.statement: A book has one record, whatever branch holds it.

capabilities.name: Check out books
capabilities.scope: Lending a book to a patron as the circulation desk does it today, from the desk manual and the branch notes.

capabilities.name: Holds queue
capabilities.scope: Queueing holds on books that are out as the circulation desk does it today, from the desk manual and the branch notes.

capabilities.name: Hold pickup window
capabilities.scope: How long a held book waits at the desk as the circulation desk does it today, from the desk manual and the branch notes.

capabilities.name: Patron record
capabilities.scope: The record of each patron as the circulation desk does it today, from the desk manual and the branch notes.

capabilities.name: Overdue report
capabilities.scope: The weekly list of overdue loans as the circulation desk does it today, from the desk manual and the branch notes.
